spacing_and_layout.generous_padding: Use p-8 to p-12 for containers, py-20 to py-32 for sections
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: For marketing pages: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with gap-8
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: For admin: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-2xl for large cards, rounded-xl for standard, rounded-full for buttons

components.navbar: Sticky header with Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70). Custom hover effect on links: background slides from left to right.
components.hero: Split layout or large image background. Overlay opacity max bg-black/40. CTA buttons should have subtle scale on hover.
components.cards: Subtle border (border-border), flat background, hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300.
components.buttons: Shadcn based. Add active scale (active:scale-95). Vibrant primary color for main CTAs.
components.admin_sidebar: Fixed left sidebar, dark or light based on theme, crisp borders (border-r border-border).
components.tables: Shadcn Table for schedule and admin lists. Hover states on rows. Clear typography for data.
components.forms: Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Validation with visual error states.

motion.page_transitions: Framer motion fade-in on scroll (initial={opacity: 0, y: 20} animate={opacity: 1, y: 0}).
motion.hover_effects: Cards and buttons subtle scaling. Nav links slide-in background.
motion.interactions: Micro-interactions on schedule filtering and news item deletion.

images.description: Modern concrete building. Use with gradient overlay for text readability.
Diverse students in a modern classroom.

testing.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind configuration with CSS variables for dynamic dark mode switching.
Implement Shadcn UI primitives for admin tables, forms, dropdowns, and dialogs.
Ensure 'Stundas saraksts' (Schedule) conflict detection is visually prominent in the admin UI (e.g., highlighting rows in red/destructive).
Apply the specific Navbar sliding background hover effect required by the prompt.
Keep all copy and route structure corresponding to Latvian sections: Jaunumi, Vēsture, Skolēniem, Skolotājiem, Stundas saraksts.
